scripts.lint: bun run --filter './packages/*' lint && oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts tests scripts
scripts.fmt:check: bun run --filter './packages/*' fmt:check && oxfmt -c oxfmt.config.ts --check tests scripts
scripts.test:integration: bun test --preload ./tests/integration/setup-dom.ts tests/integration/react-zustand.test.tsx && bun test tests/integration/vanilla.test.ts
